test-set.name: ft-Examples3.2
test-set.description: XQuery Full Text - Section 3.2 - Examples from Section 3.2

test-case.name: ft-3.2-examples-q1
test-case.description: Returns the sample book element, because its title element contains the token "Expert"

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test ft-3.2-examples-q1

test-case.test: (: 3.2 Search Tokens and Phrases: Example #1 :) //book[./title contains text "Expert"]

result.assert-xml:
Improving the Usability of a Web Site Through Expert Reviews and Usability Testing Millicent Marigold Montana Marigold Véra Tudor-Medina

The usability of a Web site is how well the site supports the users in achieving specified goals. A Web site should facilitate learning, and enable efficient and effective task completion, while propagating few errors.

This book has been approved by the Web Site Users Association.

test-case.name: ft-3.2-examples-q5
test-case.description: Returns book numbers of book elements by "Marigold" with a title about "Web Site Usability", sorting them in descending score order

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test ft-3.2-examples-q5

test-case.test: (: 3.2 Search Tokens and Phrases: Example #5 :) for $book in /books/book[.//author contains text "Marigold"] let score $score := $book/title/@shortTitle contains text "Web Site Usability" where $score > 0.1 order by $score descending return data($book/@number)

result.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
